ADD-03/3.1.old: the annual payment calculated under Clause 29
ADD-03/3.1.new: the annual payment, expressed at Base Date prices, calculated under Clause 29

ADD-03/3.2.new_text: Base Date means the date falling twenty-eight (28) days before the Proposal Due Date.

ADD-03/3.4.note: Bidders shall reflect ADD-03 Section 3 (Base Date pricing; indexation under the new Clause 29.2) in the Financial Model submitted under Volume I Clause 10.3.

ADD-03/4.1.old: The Authority does not mandate a particular process train.
ADD-03/4.1.new: The treatment process shall include a membrane filtration step, either in the tertiary treatment stage or as part of a membrane bioreactor, with a nominal pore size not exceeding 0.1 µm. Subject to the preceding sentence, the Authority does not mandate a particular process train.

ADD-03/4.2.note: Bidders shall reflect ADD-03 Section 4 (membrane filtration step, nominal pore size not exceeding 0.1 µm) in the process design submitted under Volume II Section 3.

ADD-03/Q15.note: Clause 6.4 states a minimum retention period (not less than seven years); a longer period may be proposed but is not required.

ADD-03/Q16.note: An assumption that limits or qualifies a Volume V obligation is a qualification and shall be listed in Form 4-E; a 'no deviations' statement precludes any qualification of Volume V elsewhere in the Proposal.

ADD-03/Q17.note: Where the EPC Contractor is an unincorporated JV, each member shall hold a certificate meeting Clause 8.3 and a copy of each certificate shall be submitted with Envelope A.

ADD-03/Q19.note: The Availability Payment in Form 4-F is the year 1 amount in year 1 prices; indexation under VOL-V 29.2 applies from the first anniversary of PCOD.

ADD-03/Q20.note: In the Form 4-F row 'Indexation basis assumed', the Bidder shall state, after 'Per Volume V Clause 29.2', the Indexed Proportion as a percentage; the Indexed Proportion shall not be stated anywhere in Envelope A (VOL-I 6.2 applies).

ADD-03/Q21.note: The construction methodology in the Technical Proposal shall include a crane and lifting plan demonstrating compliance with Table 5-1 (VOL-II Clause 5.6 inserted by ADD-03 Section 7).

ADD-03/7.1.new_text: The Project Company shall comply with the height limits in Table 5-1, which is reproduced at Appendix A to this Addendum as issued by the Northern Region Airspace Safeguarding Office and is incorporated into this Volume by reference.
ADD-03/7.1.note: new Clause 5.6 inserted after Clause 5.5 (engine id VOL-II:5.5+ADD-03)

ADD-03/1.1.reason: Recital. 'This Addendum is issued under Volume I Clause 5.3 and takes precedence over Addenda Nos. 1 and 2 in accordance with Volume I Clause 3.2.' It restates the existing order of precedence (VOL-I:3.2) and the power to issue Addenda (VOL-I:5.3); it changes the text of no unit. A person confirms.

ADD-03/1.2.reason: Rule of reading for this Addendum's own references: 'A reference in this Addendum to a Clause, Table or Form is to that Clause, Table or Form as amended by Addenda Nos. 1 and 2, unless otherwise stated.' The 'unless otherwise stated' exception only governs how ADD-03's references are resolved (targets are read at ADD-02, as the engine does); it changes the text of no unit. A person confirms.

ADD-03/1.3.reason: Recital applying the existing rule in VOL-I:5.2 ('Requests received after that time will not be answered.'): 'Requests for clarification received after the time stated in Volume I Clause 5.2 have not been answered.' It changes the text of no unit.

ADD-03/2.2.reason: 'The number 6.7 is not reused. The Clauses of Volume I are not renumbered.' It confirms that no renumbering follows the deletion of 6.7 under ADD-03:2.1 (escalated as ADD-03/2.1(b)); it changes no unit itself. A person confirms.

ADD-03/AppA/para1.reason: This is an introductory paragraph to Appendix A. 'Table 5-1 is reproduced below as issued by the Northern Region Airspace Safeguarding Office' describes the reproduction, and 'The Arabic text governs in accordance with Section 7 of this Addendum' points back to 7.2 rather than creating its own rule. It amends no unit and adds no obligation beyond 7.1 and 7.2. A person should confirm.
